summary: FingerMotion, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants. The offering comprises 3,958,055 shares at $0.24 per share and 12,708,611 pre-funded warrants at $0.2399 each, exercisable at $0.0001, raising approximately $4 million before expenses. The closing price on August 28, 2026, was $0.3980. The pre-funded warrants allow investors to avoid exceeding beneficial ownership limits. The offering is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. No corporate action, restructuring, or strategic event is involved. The transaction is expected to close on August 31, 2026.
